location.site_detail: Northwest of existing White Oak Business Park; local reporting places the campus between Appling and Harlem.

why_not_in_baseline: Not present in the 208 baseline canonical_project list; public Google end-user/operator identification was announced July 23-24, 2026 after the 2026-07-16 baseline freeze.

planned_buildings.note: WRDW/WAGT reported 33 buildings across two complexes on 2026-07-27; keep as conflict until official site plan/source documents are directly verified.

site_area_acres.note: WRDW/WAGT reported 3,500 acres across two complexes on 2026-07-27.

power_notes: Columbia County's 2026-07-23 news release says Google committed to pay 100% of project energy costs; no project-specific MW capacity was found in official/local sources during the 2026-08-11 refresh.

history.reason: Google and county announcement confirmed; EDACC minutes show White Oak rezoning progress, and WRDW/WAGT reported land clearing at both Google-occupied sites.
No project-specific MW was verified; statewide Georgia Power large-load figures were not assigned to this campus.

contradictions.details: DCD reports 8 million sq ft in 23 buildings on 1,900 acres northwest of White Oak Business Park; WRDW/WAGT reports two complexes, 33 buildings, and 3,500 acres in Harlem/near Appling. Official county and Google pages reviewed do not publish a project-specific building count, acreage, or MW capacity.
